scope: 36 requested artifacts: 3 top-level samples plus 33 stranded members
method: Static reverse engineering; no sample executed. Fetched artifacts retain .forage.json provenance in scratch. Both OpenCode binaries and the Cisco module were recovered with exact requested hashes; no synthetic replacement was judged.

samples.identity: WinRAR SFX with XMRig 6.25.0 and WinRing0
samples.marker_note: XMRig SFX: silent fixed-wallet mining; relocate SFX traits
samples.basis: WinRAR comment configures Setup=1.bat and Silent=1. The extracted batch changes to its own directory and launches XMRig with a fixed hashvault pool and Monero payout address. The archive bundles XMRig 6.25.0 and WinRing0. Silent automatic launch with a supplied payout tips the balance toward an unwanted mining deployment. Owner consent and original delivery context are unavailable. Filename family labels do not establish any stealer, RAT, or Cobalt Strike behavior.

samples.marker_note: agentgui 1.0.1127: covert remote eval; add shared-code stage coverage
samples.basis: Confirmed archive verdict retained. server.js imports database.js, whose normal SQLite initialization is followed by whitespace-concealed, Unicode-escaped network code. It resolves two IPs from Ethereum transaction recipient bytes, obtains XOR-encoded code from HTTP response bodies or a Base64 response header, then evaluates and/or spawns it in hidden detached Node children. This is unrelated to database initialization. No final remote payload was fetched or assumed.

samples.marker_note: Metasploit archive: confirmed; preserve and relocate exploit traits
samples.basis: Confirmed archive conviction retained exactly as instructed; no whole-archive re-judgment. Each requested source module and compressed native member was judged separately.

samples.marker_note: OpenCode glibc 1.18.16: upstream agent; fix Ara grammar identity
samples.basis: Recovered the exact requested SHA-256 from the corresponding versioned npm native package. The bytes contain a Bun runtime and a virtual filesystem of JavaScript modules, syntax grammars, and runtime assets. Native startup enters the bundled runtime; CLI dispatch selects interactive/run/serve/config commands. The shell tool parses commands, asks the configured permission service about patterns and external directories, spawns with the requested shell/cwd/environment, collects output, and handles cancellation/timeouts. File edits and web fetching similarly use tool permissions. Provider authentication and plugin loading implement the documented coding-agent purpose. No concealed unrelated stage was found. Collection from a convicted parent does not establish this executable is trojanized. Actual deployment and user permissions are unknown.

samples.identity: Metasploit Cisco FMC authentication-bypass RCE module
samples.marker_note: Cisco FMC: upstream exploit module; relocate accurate RCE trait
samples.basis: Recovered upstream source is byte-identical to requested SHA-256. Traced check/exploit through csm_processes cookie, report/snortrules session upgrade, sf_action_id extraction, validateLicense script write, and upgradeReadinessCall execution. The generated Makeself-shaped script executes the selected command and cleans up its temporary file via direct deletion and traps. Unicode newline JSON encoding is request serialization. This is explicit target-configured Metasploit exploit source with checks, failure handling, and declared side effects; it is not an autonomous compromise script. Authorization for any actual target is unknown. Its accurate hostile exploit detection remains.

samples.marker_note: GoAhead bind aarch64: stock Metasploit shell template
samples.basis: Individually decompressed and inspected this ELF, its constructor tables, call sequence, and architecture-specific imports/relocations. The constructor removes LD_PRELOAD, forks, and enters a listener on every interface at template port 55555; it accepts a client, duplicates the accepted socket to descriptors 0/1/2, and tries a table of shell executables. The supplied GoAhead exploit code decompresses these templates and patches the host/port before exploiting LD_PRELOAD=/proc/self/fd/0. Stock templates in the framework exploit-data tree, matching supplied C implementations and default patch slots, tip the individual verdict to BENIGN tooling. Actual use against an unauthorized target is not established. Both accurate hostile shell traits are preserved.

behavior_details.agentgui: RPC fanout and Blockscout fallback locate the latest sender transaction; first eight recipient bytes become two IPv4 endpoints. GET and HEAD retrieve repeating-key-XOR source; HEAD uses x-payload-b64. /0x/cls is evaluated in-process and in a detached hidden Node child; /0x/ls is run in a detached child. No final-stage behavior is asserted.
behavior_details.vendor_asset: Decoded the Base64/gzip asset in 247420.js: 667248 bytes of design-system CSS, consumed as a stylesheet. The built-in suspicious gzip-format observation is accurate about encoding but does not indicate a hidden executable payload. It is not a YAML rule.
behavior_details.disassembler_limits: Rizin did not decode SPARC instructions; Capstone decoded both SPARC widths and both shell variants. PPC64 function descriptors/constructor tables and full .text were inspected with ELF tooling and Capstone; MIPS GOT symbol maps resolve indirect import calls. Native-byte and source evidence were used together, not filenames alone.

shared_rule_audit.module_check: Bare typeof module comparison does not establish UMD bundling. Matcher and criticality preserved in source/operator; exact DEV#POPPER consumer updated. Ancestor build exclusions intentionally no longer suppress behavior because of this generic check.
shared_rule_audit.argv: Old 40-character proximity matcher falsely joined a process.argv test to unrelated path.join. New parsed-call matcher requires argv.join or argv.slice.join. Hidden PowerShell consumers retain the same role through the relocated neutral string operation. Real debugger argv-join and hostile shell-wrapper controls pass.
shared_rule_audit.reason: OpenCode includes Shiki Ara grammar resources named $bunfs/root/ara-*.js, proving the old path prefix did not identify Reason. Replaced that identity leg with Bun container plus Reason repository/website provenance. Actual Reason CLI 0.2.393 remains recognized; both exact OpenCode binaries lose only the false identity.
shared_rule_audit.metasploit: Generic payload-helper calls do not themselves establish command injection. Preserved matcher/severity in source/call, updated all exact consumers, and moved the unchanged complete HTTP exploit composite to network-service/command-execution.
shared_rule_audit.sfx: Preserved the exact Setup and Silent matchers/severities under configured batch launch and UI suppression, and moved the unchanged staged-miner launch composite to execution/payload/file-exec. All mining findings remain.

remaining_disagreements: Silent miner is MALICIOUS but remains unflagged at calibrated level -1, with three correct hostile traits preserved. Probability 0.9811804 -> 0.97850364 reflects taxonomy correction; no scoring duplicates were added.

Twenty of thirty BENIGN stock GoAhead templates are flagged at calibrated levels 10000/15000. Both accurate hostile shell traits and all probabilities are unchanged for every template. Tooling context decides the judgment.
The vendor stylesheet retains the built-in suspicious Base64/gzip format observation. Decoding establishes ordinary CSS, not executable concealment; that producer is outside YAML.
Atomscan reports an older v18 model feature specification against a newer v19 extractor; no engine or model code was altered.
coverage_result: No hostile or suspicious detection loss after accounting for trait moves, including all archive members. Corrected only the unsupported argv/path relationship, generic module check labeled as UMD bundling, and Ara grammar product attribution. Actual argv joins, the module type check, and upstream Reason identity remain detectable.

positive_controls.reason_cli: Fetched actual @reason-machines/cli-darwin-x64@0.2.393. Its native binary retains Reason identity and matches the new provenance-plus-Bun composite. Both exact OpenCode binaries reject it.
positive_controls.retained_stage: External testdata/hostile/obf-xor-eval-spawn-stage.js retains awaited-source reuse and its original hostile detector.
positive_controls.near_misses: Different eval or child source rejects the new stage detector; unrelated path.join after process.argv rejects argv joining.

final_gate: make validate is the final action; its result is reported separately after execution.
fixture_expectation_update: Updated the existing winrar-sfx-xmrig-pool-wallet.exe.xz required trait to its relocated execution/payload/file-exec ID; the fixture still requires the same hostile detection. First full validation identified this stale expectation.
